title: monki-focus key endorsement claims (v1)
description: Claims of a PASETO v4.public key endorsement, signed by the previous active key of the same purpose with footer {"kid":"<old kid>"} and implicit assertion "monki-focus/key/v1|" + iss + "|" + use. The signed message must also be the canonical serialisation of these claims (docs/protocol/unlock-tokens.md §4.0). Semantic rules beyond this schema: kid is derived from x; x passes the strict Ed25519 key checks; kid differs from the endorsing kid; iat <= nbf < exp; exp - iat <= 7776000 (90 days); iss equals the pinned issuer and use the keyring purpose.

use.description: Key purpose of the endorsed key (and of the endorsing key).

kid.description: Key id of the endorsed key: first 16 characters of base64url(SHA-256(x)).

x.description: The endorsed raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, unpadded base64url.

exp.description: Expiry of the endorsement (server time); nbf < exp.

issuer.description: Instance origin. Release: lowercase https://host, no port, path or trailing slash. Development only: http://localhost or http://127.0.0.1 with an optional non-default port. Never contains "|".

rfc3339Utc.description: UTC instant as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (whole seconds, no offset, year >= 1970). Verifiers also check that the day exists in its month (no 2026-02-30), which a pattern cannot express.
